title: Production Deadlock: Synchronous Kafka RPC consumer lag blocking checkout authorizations
summary: Synchronous request-response pattern implemented on Kafka topics deadlocked when consumer rebalances stalled payment authorization reply partitions. Direct catalyst for ADR-051 and deprecation of synchronous Kafka RPC.

title: Cascading Checkout Outage: Redis session cluster OOM eviction propagating to payment webhooks
summary: Catastrophic 4-hop cascading failure: redis-session-store memory eviction triggered 504 Gateway Timeouts in auth-token-validator, causing checkout-orchestrator backpressure, and halting stripe-webhook-worker.

title: ML Inference Worker CUDA Memory Leak & OOM Killer crash under batch tensor load
summary: PyTorch worker nodes encountering CUDA memory fragmentation and uncollected tensor graphs after 72h runtime. Mitigation documented in DOC-012.

title: ML Inference Worker CUDA Memory Leak Resurfaces: Worker nodes OOM killed on GPU shard 4
summary: Exact recurrence of INC-045: PyTorch worker nodes experiencing CUDA memory leak and OOM crash under batched tensor inference. Requires DOC-012 procedure.

title: Recommendation Engine Unmarshaling Panic: Missing required field 'account_tier' in User Profile payload
summary: recommendation-service panics when consuming user profiles following PR-398 breaking schema modification. Field account_tier was removed without backward compatibility.
